name: smwgraphics-silver-the-hedgehog
title: Silver The Hedgehog
description:
Silver The Hedgehog travels to SMW. Made by me ;).
The zip file includes:
GFX32 (Player)
GFX28 (Name)
GFX10 (Overworld Player)
GFX00 (Some Player Tiles)
SMW_Shared.pal (The character color palettes)

Also includes optional GFX:
GFX22
GFX24 (Both removes blushing frames from the vanilla ending)

And like my previous mods, the 2nd player it's a reference to another character, in this case, Blaze The Cat
